title: Martian survivors fled and some may have reached Earth

tellings.quote: I think there were people that got stuck on Mars and tried to survive by hibernating

plain: Joe McMoneagle, who worked as a remote viewer, someone trained to describe distant places using the mind alone, told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 about people on Mars in the very distant past. He says he thinks some got stuck on Mars and tried to survive by hibernating, while others fled, and some may have reached Earth. If true, it would mean humans could have roots on another planet.
